ledgerAccount.label: Linked account
ledgerAccount.foreignHint: For a foreign-currency account you would normally add its own chart account, for example 1021 Bankkonto EUR.

openingBalance.label: Opening balance
openingBalance.zeroHint: At 0.00 nothing is posted. The account still counts as registered.
openingBalance.consequence: After this you cannot import an opening balance for this account without reversing this entry first.

notStored.conflict: A rate of {stored} is already recorded for this date, and a posted line may depend on it. Record a correction under a different date.
notStored.denied: You do not have permission to record rates.

incomplete.text: You have a QR-IBAN but no plain IBAN. Payments you initiate need a plain IBAN.

list.title: No bank accounts yet.
list.hint: Register each one here with its IBAN and the chart account it books to.

noAssetAccounts.text: Your chart has no asset accounts yet. A bank account needs one.

error.transport: Bank accounts could not be loaded.
error.chart: The chart of accounts could not be loaded.

invalidIban.structure: This IBAN does not have the right length or shape.
invalidIban.missing: Enter the IBAN of this account.

error.needsLedgerAccount: Pick the chart account this bank account books to.

needsAccount9100.missing: Account 9100 Eröffnungsbilanz is missing from your chart. Without it you cannot post the balance.

needsAccount9100.archivedDetail: The account stays exactly as it is. It only becomes active again.

needsAccount9100.denied: You do not have permission to create accounts. Ask someone who does to add 9100 Eröffnungsbilanz.

notFound.text: This bank account no longer exists.

error.needsFxRate: No rate is recorded for {currency} on {date}. Enter the rate here.
error.openingBalanceAlreadySet: This account already has a posted opening balance. A correction is a reversing entry in the journal.
error.accountInUse: Locked since the opening balance was posted. You can still change the name.

permissionDenied.write: You do not have permission to register bank accounts.
permissionDenied.read: You do not have permission to view bank accounts.
permissionDenied.post: You do not have permission to post the opening balance.

channel.title: Bank channel
channel.empty: No EBICS channel yet. Connect one to stop importing statements and uploading payment files by hand: your bank must offer EBICS, and the file-based path keeps working either way.
channel.filePathNote: The file-based statement import and payment upload always remain available, with or without a channel.
channel.locked: Managing a bank channel needs the payment capability.

managed.formIntro: With bLink you grant consent inside your own e-banking, no paper letter.

consent.waitingBank: Your bank's login will open so you can grant consent there.
consent.revoked: Consent was revoked at your bank. Reconnect to grant it again.
consent.scopeMissing: This connection has no payment consent. Reconnect with PSS to submit payments.

channel.formatUnsupported: This bank delivers only JSON over bLink. The file-based rails remain the floor.

cloudTier.title: Managed connectivity
cloudTier.explainer: Managed bLink connectivity is an optional tier your owner enables. EBICS and file import keep working without it.
cloudTier.suspended: The managed connectivity vendor account has lapsed. Your EBICS and file rails are unaffected.

channel.releaseNoteBlink: Submitted over bLink. Release the payment in your own e-banking.
channel.unmatchedAccount: Statement for an unrouted account (route it, then sync again)
channel.transmitInDoubt: An upload's outcome is unknown: retransmission is blocked until the bank's protocol answers.
channel.bankKeysChanged: The bank's keys changed. All traffic is halted until you re-confirm them out of band.
channel.disconnectBlockConfirm: Really block this connection? All of its orders are halted.
channel.disconnectRetireConfirm: Really retire this connection? The bank feed is closed for good.

wizard.accessData: EBICS access data from your bank contract
wizard.confirmKeys: Compare and confirm the bank keys

error.generic: Something went wrong. Nothing on the money path was changed.

notice.noEbicsOffer: This bank offers no EBICS. Use the file-based import and upload path instead.
notice.needsBankTransport: Keys were generated and the INI letter filed locally. Sending them to the bank needs a wired EBICS transport.
notice.channelUnreachable: The bank could not be reached. The last sync stays visible; retry is the one action.
notice.bankKeysMismatch: The bank keys did not match. This is a hard stop, never auto-accepted.
notice.needsConfirmation: This is a deliberate act and needs your confirmation.
notice.permissionDenied: You do not hold the capability for this action.
notice.cloudTier: Managed bLink connectivity is an optional tier your owner enables. EBICS and file import keep working without it.
notice.consentRevoked: Consent was revoked at your bank. Reconnect to grant it again.
notice.consentScopeMissing: This connection has no payment consent. Reconnect with PSS to submit payments.
notice.formatUnsupported: This bank delivers only JSON over bLink. The file-based rails remain the floor.
notice.cloudTierSuspended: The managed connectivity vendor account has lapsed. Your EBICS and file rails are unaffected.
notice.alreadyTransmitted: This batch is already in flight over another rail.

bankPicker.label: Bank
bankPicker.empty: Bank not found. Enter the EBICS access data below by hand.

keystore.title: Key storage
keystore.locked: Locked: the passphrase was not entered this session.
keystore.unavailable: The key file is missing or corrupt. Re-initialise the connection (the bank contract is unaffected), or restore the file from backup.
keystore.notPersistent: This key storage does not survive a restart. The keys must be generated again if the app restarts before you connect a persistent store.

schedule.title: Automatic fetch
schedule.egressNote: Turning this on creates a stored rule that contacts your bank on a schedule: scheduled network egress, unattended.
schedule.inactive: This schedule is on but nothing is driving it: the local M00 scheduler is not running. Sync now still works, or start the scheduler.

BankAccounts.title: Bank accounts
BankAccounts.body: The register of your bank accounts with IBAN, QR-IBAN and opening balance. A QR-IBAN can only receive payments; outgoing payments need an ordinary IBAN in the register as well, and the surface points it out when one is missing. Here you also manage the EBICS channel and archive accounts that are no longer in use.
